what_happened.line: The Capital Planning Committee voted unanimously to recommend its revised (rev B) capital project ranking, replacing the list it recommended at the previous meeting.
Rev B recombined each member's individual 1-to-29 rankings after duplicate and gap rankings were cleaned up and the Flat Hill drainage project was removed.
Members discussed the turf field feasibility study against McNally Park, and whether it would fall below the funding line.

The final ranking is to be emailed to the town manager, and at least one January meeting is planned, depending on the town manager's budget work.

why_it_matters: The ranking sets the order in which capital projects are considered for funding, so where the funding line falls decides which projects reach town meeting and what is borrowed or paid from taxes.
How the ambulance is paid for (capital list, ARPA or a stabilization fund) changes how far down the list gets funded, though the minutes record no decision on it.
